title: phaeocephalum inexpansum
intro: Phaeocephalum inexpansum, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae, is a medicinal plant native to tropical regions. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
